title: Shared WebFlux JSON codecs across server and clients
summary: Both original Boot source slices compiled on one reconstructed July 2017 codec profile. The parent emitted firstName and read a snake-case POST as null. The merge emitted first_name, decoded Lin, and both injected clients decoded Mia.

change.description: Shared WebFlux JSON codecs across server and clients

verdictLabel: 3/3 merged predictions matched on the reconstructed profile
notes: Six unmodified Framework codec configuration sources from 2ccbc55ffdff supply the historical method names. Boot 2.0.0.M2 supplies unchanged dependencies, Framework RC3 supplies the remaining HTTP classes, and Jackson 2.9.0.pr4 supplies the nonblocking parser. All JAR and source digests and the original loaded providers are recorded.
The July 2017 published snapshot binaries are unavailable. The earlier parent-slice/M3 release comparison is retained as a separate profile.
